build_segformer_head: build a SegformerHead instance with bilinear interpolation for semantic segmentation decode head
forward_segformer_head: run the SegformerHead forward pass on multi-scale backbone feature maps to produce segmentation logits
review_segformer_head_loss: review the SegformerHead loss method that computes segmentation loss from multi-level inputs and data samples
refactor_segformer_head_convs: refactor the SegformerHead convs ModuleList to use different kernel sizes or normalization configs
summarize_segformer_head_fusion: summarize the SegformerHead fusion_conv layer that concatenates and fuses multi-scale feature outputs
